sn35.96:1.1: parihānadhammañca vo bhikkhave, desissāmi aparihāna dhammañca cha ca abhibhāyatanāni.
sn35.96:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojanīyā.
sn35.96:1.5: tañce bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na vyantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti. veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā,
sn35.96:1.7: parihānaṃ hetaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā uppajjanti …pe… puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe…
sn35.96:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.96:2.2: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojanīyā.
sn35.96:2.3: tañce bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na vyantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti, veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā,
sn35.96:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā.
sn35.96:3.3: tañce bhikkhu nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā,
sn35.96:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.96:4.2: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojanīyā.
sn35.96:4.3: tañce bhikkhu nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā,
sn35.96:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave aparihāna dhammo hoti.
sn35.96:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nuppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā.
sn35.96:5.5: abhibhāyatanaṃ hetaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.96:5.6: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nuppajjanti pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojanīyā.
